SELECT 
    t1.devregistry AS device_registry,
    t1.makername AS manufacturer_name,
    t1.modnum AS model_number,
    t2.scraccy AS performance_score,
    t3.ergorate AS comfort,
    t3.devscope AS classification
FROM 
    deviceidentity AS t1
JOIN 
    performance AS t2 ON t1.devregistry = t2.perfregistry
JOIN 
    testsessions AS t3 ON t1.devregistry = t3.sessionregistry
WHERE 
    t3.devscope = 'Mouse';
